propositions: CLI reference syntax and options must derive deterministically from registry enumeration and committed package-help bytes without source regex or manual command census.
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with byte-exact committed output and no side effects from operation/config/store/handler imports.
Full-extra validation must resolve every lazy handler/parser/selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping without executing command logic.
Editorial prose (preamble, examples, rationale) must be structurally separate from generated syntax sections and linted to reject invalid usage/option tables and unknown command spellings.
The same repo-local commands for generator checks and help rendering must work both locally and in portable CI, with rebar-mcp tested as a separate entry point.
Overview/help/exit-code test coverage must enumerate all route classes from the registry rather than reconstructing policy sets manually.
